description: Adds missing Romanian diacritics (ă â î ș ț) from a dictionary of ~70,000 words, fixes the old cedilla letters (ş ţ to ș ț), or removes diacritics. With `add`, words that can be spelled more than one way get the most common form and are listed with their alternatives.

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

mode.description: add: put diacritics in; fix: ş ţ to ș ț; remove: strip them

output.description: Write the result to this file instead of returning it

name: romanian_diacritics
title: Romanian diacritics
